Lowa is a rock gnome member of the Church of Gond, found enslaved in the Steel Watch Foundry.
“
I just want my son to be safe. That's it. Please - don't let him die. Don't let any of them die.
„
— Lowa

Involvement

Lowa can be found on the lab floor of the foundry talking to Black Gauntlet Tamia Holzt, and later battling Black Gauntlet of Banes. She wears a  Kill Collar, which must be disabled by deactivating a  Motivator held by one of the Black Gauntlets.

If saveing her as part of the quest ⁠Save the Gondians, she runs out of the lab and gathers with the rest of the Gondians outside of the foundry.

Idle banter

Lowa can be seen having a conversation with  Tamia Holzt:

  • Black Gauntlet Tamia Holzt
    Your output is pathetic, Gondian. Explain yourself.
    • Gondian Lowa
      I am trying, Overseer.
      • Black Gauntlet Tamia Holzt
        'Trying' isn't an explanation. Why are the gyronetics incomplete?
        • Gondian Lowa
          Because my eyes burn from lack of sleep!
          • Black Gauntlet Tamia Holzt
            Was that a complaint?
            • Gondian Lowa
              You asked for an explanation, and I gave you one.
  • Black Gauntlet Tamia Holzt
    You forget yourself, Gondian. Your quota is now doubled.
    • Gondian Lowa
      Are you out of your mind? You can't snap your fingers and expect the impossible!
      • Black Gauntlet Tamia Holzt
        I just did.
        • Gondian Lowa
          Please - I'm so tired. If I could sleep, just for a little while, I could finish this Watcher.
  • Black Gauntlet Tamia Holzt
    Don't make me triple your quota, Gondian. Back to work.
    • Gondian Lowa
      Overseer, please.

Witnessing this conversation grants the inspiration ⁠The Means of Coercion to party members with the Noble background.
